description: This file declares the DrmHalAidl class, which implements the IDrm interface for Android's DRM system using AIDL. It includes method declarations for DRM operations such as session management, key handling, property access, and event handling, along with external dependencies and type definitions.

classes.name: DrmHalAidl
classes.description: Implementation of the IDrm interface for Android DRM using AIDL, providing methods for DRM session and key management, property access, and event handling.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks the initialization status of the DRM plugin.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific crypto scheme (identified by UUID) is supported for a given MIME type and security level.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a DRM plugin instance for a given UUID and application package name.

methods.name: destroyPlugin
methods.description: Destroys the current DRM plugin instance.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a new DRM session with a specified security level.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes an existing DRM session identified by session ID.

methods.name: getKeyRequest
methods.description: Generates a key request for a given session, init data, MIME type, and key type.

methods.name: provideKeyResponse
methods.description: Provides a response to a key request, returning a key set ID.

methods.name: removeKeys
methods.description: Removes keys associated with a given key set ID.

methods.name: restoreKeys
methods.description: Restores keys for a session using a key set ID.

methods.name: queryKeyStatus
methods.description: Queries the status of keys in a session.

methods.name: getProvisionRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning request.

methods.name: provideProvisionResponse
methods.description: Provides a response to a provisioning request.

methods.name: getSecureStops
methods.description: Retrieves secure stops.

methods.name: getSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs.

methods.name: getSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves a specific secure stop.

methods.name: releaseSecureStops
methods.description: Releases secure stops.

methods.name: removeSecureStop
methods.description: Removes a specific secure stop.

methods.name: removeAllSecureStops
methods.description: Removes all secure stops.

methods.name: getHdcpLevels
methods.description: Retrieves HDCP levels.

methods.name: getNumberOfSessions
methods.description: Gets current and maximum number of DRM sessions.

methods.name: getSecurityLevel
methods.description: Retrieves security level for a session.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseKeySetIds
methods.description: Gets offline license key set IDs.

methods.name: removeOfflineLicense
methods.description: Removes an offline license.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseState
methods.description: Gets the state of an offline license.

methods.name: getPropertyString
methods.description: Retrieves a property value as a string.

methods.name: getPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Retrieves a property value as a byte array.

methods.name: setPropertyString
methods.description: Sets a property value as a string.

methods.name: setPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Sets a property value as a byte array.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metrics.

methods.name: setCipherAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the cipher algorithm for a session.

methods.name: setMacAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the MAC algorithm for a session.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data within a session.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data within a session.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs data within a session.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a signature within a session.

methods.name: signRSA
methods.description: Performs RSA signing within a session.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets a DRM event listener.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder is required for a MIME type.

methods.name: setPlaybackId
methods.description: Sets the playback ID for a session.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves DRM log messages.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves supported DRM schemes.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles DRM events.

methods.name: onExpirationUpdate
methods.description: Handles expiration updates.

methods.name: onKeysChange
methods.description: Handles key status changes.

methods.name: onSessionLostState
methods.description: Handles session lost state notifications.
